name: What should I look for in a contractor for foreclosed property drywall repair?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a contractor for foreclosed property drywall repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for foreclosed property drywall repair, prioritize experience with renovation projects and specific expertise in moisture damage and mold remediation. Ensure they are licensed and insured in California. Look for strong references, transparent pricing, and a clear understanding of the project scope. A contractor who communicates effectively and offers a detailed proposal instills confidence. City Dweller, LLC specializes in these types of repairs in the Bay Area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for licensed, insured contractors experienced in renovations, moisture damage, and mold remediation, with good references and clear communication.
